description: Deep Learning Road Surfaces 2023 (LGATE-482) is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Landgate. Road Surfaces derived from imagery captured across Western Australia using a deep learning algorithm. The algorithm was created in-house within Landgate to demonstrate to approved State and Local Government (Government) entities the capabilities of Deep Learning [DL] and Artificial Intelligence [AI] algorithms. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Landgate. Its tags are 2023, AI, Deep Learning, Landgate, ML. It offers 10 resource(s) in .pdf, api arcgis server feature service, api arcgis server map service, fgdb, geojson. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Custom (Other). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
